records.source_statement: Separate heading 'Whether a man shall Marry' introduces general yes/no testimony.
limitations: Section follows prior intervention causes on printed307.

records.source_statement: Moon beholding Sun or Venus by good aspect, or mutual first/seventh lord placement or good aspect, is given as positive testimony for marrying.
limitations: Source gives multiple alternative favourable testimonies.

records.source_statement: Signifiers in prolific signs or Venus' dignities are additional pro-marriage testimony.
limitations: Source says these strengthen prospects, not a measured fertility test.

records.source_statement: Separate heading 'The time of Marriage' shifts from yes/no to duration.
limitations: Not an independent couple or second prophecy.

records.source_statement: Degree gap to applying Moon–Sun/Venus or first/seventh rulers is mapped to DAYS if movable, MONTHS if common, YEARS if fixed signs.
limitations: Requires particular application and source sign modality.

records.source_statement: Lilly restricts that days/months/years timing method to strong marriage testimonies and SWIFT significators.
limitations: Without both prerequisites, the simple scale is not admitted.

records.source_statement: A new subsection asks how many husbands a woman will have.
limitations: Historical gendered method, not verified marital history.

records.source_statement: Arabic rule counts planets between degree of tenth cusp and Mars as proposed husbands.
limitations: Requires correct zodiac-longitude direction, not human observation.

records.source_statement: If Mars is in eleventh, source instructs counting from Mars to Jupiter instead; other authors count Mars to tenth lord.
limitations: These are rival source procedures, not necessarily interchangeable.

records.source_statement: Lilly states plurality is better judged from seventh-house ruler, rather than treating Arabic planetary-count rule as universally best.
limitations: Keep authorial hierarchy and criticism of alternatives.

records.source_statement: Common signs for Sun/Mars, many planets in seventh or Sun trine/sextile many planets in seventh are given as multiplicity indicators.
